-- PA-1: Brian Fitzpatrick (R) vs B. Harvie (D, won 65.1%)
UPDATE house_races SET candidate1_name = 'Brian Harvie', candidate1_party = 'D', candidate2_name = 'Brian Fitzpatrick', candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'PA' AND district = '1';

-- PA-3: Chris Rabb won D primary (44.3%), R nominee is not listed (safe D district, likely no R)
-- PA-3 is a deep blue Philadelphia district - R candidate may not exist or is a token candidate
-- Keep Rabb as D nominee, clear candidate2 since no R candidate confirmed
UPDATE house_races SET candidate1_name = 'Chris Rabb', candidate1_party = 'D', candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL
WHERE state_code = 'PA' AND district = '3';

-- IN-8: Mark Messmer (R incumbent) vs Mary Allen (D nominee)
UPDATE house_races SET candidate1_name = 'Mary Allen', candidate1_party = 'D', candidate2_name = 'Mark Messmer', candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'IN' AND district = '8';

-- OH-15: Don Leonard (D) vs Mike Carey (R) - OH-15 is solidly R, Mike Carey was the incumbent
-- From Ballotpedia: R nominee is Mike Carey (unopposed)
UPDATE house_races SET candidate1_name = 'Don Leonard', candidate1_party = 'D', candidate2_name = 'Mike Carey', candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'OH' AND district = '15';

SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races WHERE (state_code = 'PA' AND district IN ('1','3')) 
   OR (state_code = 'IN' AND district = '8')
   OR (state_code = 'OH' AND district = '15')
ORDER BY state_code, CAST(district AS UNSIGNED);
